en:
Takakage, to head the Kobayakawa,
went to Takayama Castle. Meanwhile...

Mikawa, a province far from Aki.
The Matsudaira clan ruled here,
but under repeated invasions by
Oda Nobuhide of Owari,
its rule was far from stable.
Clan head Hirotada asked Suruga's
mighty Imagawa Yoshimoto for aid,
and as the price, he had promised
to send his heir, Takechiyo, as a
hostage.
Matsudaira Takechiyo, too, like
Takakage, was leaving the land
where he was born and raised.
Not, however, to become a clan head,
but to become a hostage...

note: Takechiyo is a boy addressing his own escort; kept curt but dignified.
Glossary castle + 'Castle Interior', same pattern as U01440. Shared by 2 occurrences.

en:
Oda Nobunaga and Takechiyo...
The meeting of these two, who would
later shake this age of war, was still
no more than a single drop of water
let fall upon the surface.

But in time its ripples would spread
far and wide, reaching even the
lands of the Mouri.



And so, several years passed...
